name: USD/CAD SMA Crossover - Fixed TP/SL
description: Long/short strategy on USD/CAD using 20/50/200-day SMAs on 1H timeframe. Long when 20 crosses above 50 or 200, short when crossing below. Position sizing: 3 standard lots (300,000 units) for 20×50 crosses, 6 standard lots (600,000 units) for 20×200 crosses. Exit at 100 pips profit OR 50 pips stop loss.
source:
# USD/CAD SMA Crossover - Fixed TP/SL
# Long/short strategy using 20/50/200-day SMAs on 1H timeframe
# Position sizing: 3 lots (300k) for 20x50, 6 lots (600k) for 20x200
# Exit: 100 pips TP (0.01), 50 pips SL (0.005)

# Data source - 1H timeframe
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# SMAs converted to hourly periods (24 trading hours per day)
# 20-day = 480 periods, 50-day = 1200 periods, 200-day = 4800 periods
sma_20 = ma(period=480, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=1200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=4800, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Crossover signals for 20x50
cross_20_above_50 = crossover(sma_20, sma_50)
cross_20_below_50 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_50)

# Crossover signals for 20x200
cross_20_above_200 = crossover(sma_20, sma_200)
cross_20_below_200 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_200)

# Long entry: 20 crosses above 50 OR 20 crosses above 200
long_entry = cross_20_above_50 or cross_20_above_200

# Short entry: 20 crosses below 50 OR 20 crosses below 200
short_entry = cross_20_below_50 or cross_20_below_200

# Position sizing based on which crossover triggered
# 300,000 units (3 standard lots) for 20x50 crosses
# 600,000 units (6 standard lots) for 20x200 crosses
# If both happen (rare), use larger size (600k)
size_20x50 = 300000
size_20x200 = 600000

# Calculate position size based on signal type
# Long size
long_size_from_50 = size_20x50 if cross_20_above_50 else 0
long_size_from_200 = size_20x200 if cross_20_above_200 else 0
long_size = long_size_from_200 if long_size_from_200 > 0 else long_size_from_50

# Short size
short_size_from_50 = size_20x50 if cross_20_below_50 else 0
short_size_from_200 = size_20x200 if cross_20_below_200 else 0
short_size = short_size_from_200 if short_size_from_200 > 0 else short_size_from_50

# Combined size (only one direction will be active at a time)
position_units = long_size if long_entry else short_size

# Entry/Exit zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing - fixed unit sizing
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=position_units)

# Take profit: 100 pips = 0.01 price movement for USD/CAD
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=0.01)

# Stop loss: 50 pips = 0.005 price movement for USD/CAD  
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=0.005)
